title: C08 membership verification
description: The Team's out-of-band verification of the actual participant behind one invitation: somebody acting for the Team confirmed, in person, on a live call or through a channel the Team already trusts, that this person holds the exact device credential they proved in the exchange, which `binding_digest` names by its principal binding. A copied name or code, a login or an e-mail address is none of these, so none has a value here. The invitee's consent names this record, and a membership admitted by invitation rests on both. The verifier is the actor of the request that records it; the runtime writes who verified and when.
